What it does: A piece that hides part of a target from shooters. The dice are in section 5.7
A piece that hides part of a target from shooters, and protects more than light cover. The dice are in section 5.7
Thick concrete, hull plate, bulkheads. Blocks sight and shots completely (section 5.7)
Rubble, thick growth, deep mud. Moving through it halves the distance (section 5.4)
Fire, live wires, acid. A fighter who enters it makes a Routine Grit test (section 5.4)
Water. A fighter who cannot swim has 1 inch less on a Move action through it (section 5.4)
A river, a flooded hold, a sump. It is also **Wet**. A Routine Grit test to enter and each activation in it (section 5.4)
A wall stub, a row of crates, a pipe, a rail: up to 1 inch high. It is also **light cover**. Crossing: section 5.4
A barricade, a fence, a stacked pile: more than 1 and up to 2 inches high. It is also **heavy cover**. Crossing: section 5.4
A fixed ladder. Climbing it: section 5.4
A machine with a voice: a door, lift, charging station or turret. It can be prompted (section 8.2)
